# Artifact index

> **Back to:** [README](../../README.md) · [Documentation index](../index.md)

Every installable artifact in the catalog, with the packs that hold it, the tools it installs into, and the command that installs it.

Each command installs for the tool set up in your project, or Claude Code when none is; add `--target <name>` to install for another.

Tools: Claude Code (`claude`), GitHub Copilot (`copilot`), Open standard (Agent Skills) (`agents-standard`), OpenAI Codex (`codex`), Cursor (`cursor`), Antigravity (`antigravity`), OpenCode (`opencode`).

The main session and every other agent are not affected. | essentials, dotnet-starter, python-starter, react-starter, typescript-starter, angular-starter | claude | `sigil add hook:shared/reviewer-bash-guard` |

Plan files and anything under ~/.claude stay editable. Does nothing while worker mode is off. | deepseek-worker | claude | `sigil add hook:shared/worker-mode-guard` |
